# onetsolutions_instance_size (Data Source)

Looks up an instance size (vCPUs, memory, disks, prices) by `id` or by `slug`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_instance_size" "small" {
  slug = "p-4"
}

output "small_monthly_price" {
  value = one([for p in data.onetsolutions_instance_size.small.pricing : p.price if p.billing_cycle == "monthly"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The UUID of the size. Exactly one of `id` and `slug` is required.
- `slug` (String) The slug of the size, such as `p-4`. Exactly one of `id` and `slug` is required.

### Read-Only

- `addons` (Attributes List) The add-ons that can be ordered with the size, for the instance's `addon_ids`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addons))
- `bandwidth_mbps` (Number) The network bandwidth, in Mbit/s.
- `cpu_model` (String) The CPU model of the size, such as `epyc-9554`.
- `description` (String) The description of the size (Markdown).
- `name` (String) The display name of the size.
- `pricing` (Attributes List) The price of the size for each billing cycle it is sold with, excluding VAT. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pricing))
- `ram_mb` (Number) The memory, in MB.
- `vcpu` (Number) The number of virtual CPUs.
- `volumes` (Attributes List) The volume configurations the size can be installed on; the instance's `volume_id` takes one of their `id`s. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes))

<a id="nestedatt--addons"></a>
### Nested Schema for `addons`

Read-Only:

- `billing_type` (String) How the add-on is billed, such as `recurring`.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the add-on.
- `is_included` (Boolean) Whether the size includes it at no cost.
- `name` (String) The name of the add-on.
- `slug` (String) The slug of the add-on.


<a id="nestedatt--pricing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pricing`

Read-Only:

- `billing_cycle` (String) The billing cycle, such as `monthly`.
- `discount_percent` (String) The discount of the cycle, in percent.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether it is the size's default cycle.
- `price` (String) The price per cycle, in EUR, as a decimal string.


<a id="nestedatt--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volumes`

Read-Only:

- `disk_gb` (Number) The disk size, in GB.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the volume configuration.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether it is used when no `volume_id` is given.
- `volume_type` (String) The disk type, such as `nvme` or `ssd`.
